extractionMethod: Captured source-defined skill tuples [name, description, handler key, base cooldown] and matched them to the parity matrix; special multi-kit characters retain their source variants.
importantTimingNote: declaredBaseCooldown is the value in source skill metadata. The offline cast path applies per-skill timing wrappers: regular skills generally use base*1.16 plus small jitter; ultimates are later re-armed to max(7.5, base*0.58). Character-specific wrappers may alter final behavior. This catalog does not claim that the server reproduces all of those wrappers.

skills.name: THE ANSWER ENGINE
skills.description: A huge wireframe logo unfolds over the void. Three sources pin down a predicted location; warning lines lock, then converge into an avoidable, geometric verdict.

fighters.name: Celestial Lover

skills.name: Royal Step
skills.description: The King moves exactly one square (any direction). The squares he leaves and lands on burn and slow.

skills.name: Castling Vow
skills.description: King and Queen swap squares. Rook towers crash down on both and the pair gains a shield.

skills.name: Knight’s Fork
skills.description: A knight leaps in an L onto the rival’s square. Then all eight L-squares around it detonate: stand next to the knight, not an L away.

skills.name: ROYAL CHECK
skills.description: The board goes dark. Five checker squares are struck by pillars of light, then CHECKMATE lands on the centre. Then the pair DUET.

skills.name: Rook’s Lane
skills.description: A crimson rook sweeps the whole rank or file of the rival’s square.

skills.name: Bishop’s Cross
skills.description: Two bishops cut both full diagonals through the rival’s square. Step off the X.

skills.name: Pawn Storm
skills.description: Five pawns march abreast and close in diagonally. Slip through the gaps.

skills.name: QUEEN’S GAMBIT
skills.description: Eight queen-lines radiate from the rival, then a pillar falls on the centre. Safe squares sit between rays. The King mends the crown. Then the pair DUET.

fighters.name: Focalors

skills.name: Salon Solitaire
skills.description: Her three attendants take the stage in turn: Usher’s rapier line, Chevalmarin’s pearl cannon, then Crabaletta’s bubble snap on the rival’s predicted spot.

skills.name: Oceanid Choir
skills.description: Spectral Oceanids, the kin she rose from, spiral out and home in. Ousia sends five heavy spirits, Pneuma seven light ones.

skills.name: Oratrice’s Scale
skills.description: The scales of the Oratrice descend over the rival’s predicted position. After a visible warning they tip and crash, rooting and CONDEMNING anyone beneath.

skills.name: SINNER’S FINALE
skills.description: ACT I the Opera Epiclese materialises and every rival is marked a sinner. ACT II the Primordial Sea rises. ACT III the Oratrice delivers its verdicts. ACT IV she sentences herself: the throne shatters, the Authority is released, and Absolution floods the stage.

fighters.name: Eidolon

skills.name: Mirage Volley
skills.description: Five glitching orbs fan out. Mid-flight they resolve: one is REAL (fast, homing, heavy), the rest are ILLUSIONS that pop into glitter and leave a sleeping trap. Which one is real?

skills.name: Cups & Balls
skills.description: Three cups land on the rival’s square and SHUFFLE in plain sight. Then they lift: one hid the real blast, the others hid only doves. Follow the right cup.

skills.name: Vanishing Act
skills.description: Eidolon vanishes in smoke. Three fakes bolt off in different directions while the real one steps out behind the rival with a strike. TA-DA.

skills.name: THE WORLD IS A LIE
skills.description: I) The lights die, then the rival is drawn as a MIRRORED reflection nowhere near its true place while real attacks land. II) A fake K.O. and a fake VICTORY play out while the attacks keep coming; real ones cast shadows, fakes do not. III) The world snaps back, everything freezes, the mirror replays what you missed, and shatters.

fighters.name: Null

skills.name: Dead Pixel
skills.description: Three hollow pins fan out. Each pin DELETES the first enemy shot it touches, and every pin that lands scrubs an ERASURE stack onto the rival.

skills.name: Cut / Paste
skills.description: Null cuts a square out of reality (it goes blank) and PASTES the copy onto the rival, Null included. The copy lands, hits, then deletes itself in a pixel dissolve.

skills.name: [CORRUPT.EXE]
skills.description: A black censor bar slams across the rival (shots deleted, skills return nothing). Then their data CORRUPTS for 5 seconds: every shot, skill and blow they throw is turned back on themselves.

skills.name: END OF FILE
skills.description: I) SELECT ALL. Floor tiles are deleted and never come back. II) The world inverts and the rival is CORRUPTED: everything they throw hits them while tears open across the arena. III) A scan line deletes everything below it, the page goes blank, and reality reloads on the rival WITHOUT a floor: the arena stays DELETED until the match ends and anyone standing on nothing bleeds, harder the longer it lasts.

fighters.name: Manacle Star

skills.name: Tether Snap
skills.description: A chain hooks the rival and yanks them into melee range.

skills.name: Link Cage
skills.description: Chain links form a ring around the rival that slows and roots them while they are inside.

skills.name: Counterweight
skills.description: She swings the tethered rival like a flail into a wall for bonus damage.

skills.name: SEVER THE LEASH
skills.description: She breaks all her own Seals at once. Four chains anchor the rival to the arena corners and pull taut, dealing damage that scales with tension, while loose links orbit her as blades.

fighters.name: Seraphim

skills.name: Cover the Face
skills.description: Her wings fold over her eyes for 1.5s. She takes much less damage and reflects the first projectile. When it ends her eyes snap open and fire one homing feather per hit absorbed.

skills.name: Cover the Feet
skills.description: She plants and her wings sweep low, igniting a ring of white-gold fire. It burns rivals and pushes them out, and she cannot be knocked back inside it.

skills.name: Take Flight
skills.description: She spirals through the arena trailing text-printed feathers. Any rival she touches is Witnessed and takes bonus damage for a few seconds.

skills.name: HOLY · HOLY · HOLY
skills.description: She unfolds six wings and rises crying Holy, Holy, Holy while cloud fills the arena and clears every projectile and hazard. Hundreds of eyes open and lock onto every rival. A single coal lance strikes the main rival, dealing huge damage and cleansing her debuffs. If she is Thrice-Holy, the third strike doubles.

fighters.name: Odette

skills.name: Stellar Pirouette
skills.description: A gliding spin-dash. Rings of starlight bloom where she starts and where she lands.

skills.name: Constellation Feathers
skills.description: Five star-feathers, joined by threads of light, curve toward the rival.

skills.name: Lunar Lake Embrace
skills.description: A moonlit lake of stars slows the rival. Odette gains a shield and a little health.

skills.name: SWAN SONG · STELLAR LAMENT
skills.description: Stars fall one by one on the rival, then a great final bow blooms outward and mends her.

skills.name: Umbra Fouetté
skills.description: A razor dash that leaves a crescent blade of eclipse light behind her.

skills.name: Dark Matter Plumes
skills.description: Seven black-hole feathers hunt the rival.

skills.name: Odile’s Eclipse Step
skills.description: Collapses into shadow and reappears behind the rival with a corona burst.

skills.name: 32 FOUETTÉS · SUPERNOVA TURN
skills.description: Eight telegraphed eclipse spins spiral around the rival, then one crushing supernova turn.

skills.name: Pas de Deux · Twin Comets
skills.description: Two crossing comets, one white and one black, streak through the rival.

skills.name: Zodiac Arabesque
skills.description: A spinning astrolabe of light and shadow follows and slows the rival.

skills.name: Blood Moon Révérence
skills.description: A great bow raises a blood moon that detonates for heavy damage and wraps her in a shield.

skills.name: ODÉLIA · BIG BANG CURTAIN CALL
skills.description: The cosmic curtain falls. Twelve beams turn around the rival, then the finale erupts and she heals.

fighters.name: Steve

skills.name: Pickaxe Rush · Anvil Slam
skills.description: Dash attack: Steve charges with his pickaxe, hops up, conjures an anvil under his feet and drops straight down on the rival. Broken blocks drop materials.

skills.name: Create Block · TNT
skills.description: Builds a cobble wall that stops shots and bumps rivals away, plus a small shield. A TNT block is primed where the rival is heading.

skills.name: Minecart · Elytra Rocket
skills.description: Lays rails and rams through the rival, trapping them in the cart. Iron makes it hit harder. Then Steve opens his Elytra, boosts with a firework rocket and bursts into a firework shower.

skills.name: FINAL SMASH · HOUSE OF BOOM
skills.description: A giant piston launches the rival into a cave of TNT, zombies and Creepers. Everything blows up, then Steve eats a victory steak.

fighters.name: Button

skills.name: Thread Snare
skills.description: Button fires a golden thread that wraps the rival and slows them. Stored Loneliness makes it last longer.

skills.name: Sewn Together
skills.description: A magic stitch ties Button to the rival. If the two drift too far apart, the thread snaps and deals damage.

skills.name: Spare Me a Moment
skills.description: Button dashes away and leaves a plush decoy behind. If a rival attacks it, the decoy bursts into golden needles.

skills.name: YOU PROMISED YOU WOULDN'T LEAVE
skills.description: Threads fill the arena and a giant abandoned dollhouse rises behind it, its windows full of tiny eyes. Golden threads bind the rival, the house closes its doors, and every thread snaps at once in a massive shockwave.
